title: Contributing to hvtiRtables
text: Thank contributing! guide covers two tracks: Track — Porting SAS table macro (biostatisticians analysts): adding new table-building function mirrors SAS macro team already uses. Track B — Package infrastructure (R package developers): dependency changes, CI, testing, CRAN-style compliance.

what: Track A — Porting a SAS table macro
title: Contributing to hvtiRtables
text: SAS table macro (e.g. %summarytable) want add R equivalent: Create R/hv--table.R — one file per function. Write function thin wrapper gtsummary — package’s whole premise “starts gtsummary object.” Reuse gtsummary::tbl_summary()/add_p()/add_difference()’s existing, tested statistical machinery rather reimplementing test selection, p-values, standardized differences. function’s job translating house-style interface (grouped variable lists, SAS-macro-familiar parameter names) right gtsummary call — computing statistics scratch. Feed result existing renderers — hv_man_table()/ hv_man_table_save() flat CORR house style, hv_man_table_jtcvs()/hv_man_table_save_jtcvs() JTCVS submissions. Don’t invent new table class new renderer unless existing one genuinely express output shape. Write roxygen docs — include @param (naming SAS-parameter equivalent argument, e.g. “%summarytable PP= equivalent”), @return, @seealso, @examples. Run devtools::document() regenerate NAMESPACE .Rd files. Add migration cheat-sheet section README.md — heading named macro ported (“Migrating %yourmacro SAS macro”), parameter-mapping table listing every SAS macro argument R equivalent explicitly marking supported, worked side--side example showing real macro call next equivalent R call. Add function right section _pkgdown.yml. Write tests tests/testthat/test-hv--table.R (matching existing hyphenated file naming): input validation, documented option, least one characterization test real example table one available. See test-hv-man-table-jtcvs.R’s “reproduces template’s header/section shape” test pattern — synthetic data engineered reproduce real table’s actual N counts section grouping, since real patient-level data rarely available check repo. Update NEWS.md current dev version. Open pull request main.

title: Contributing to hvtiRtables
text: changes DESCRIPTION, CI workflows, testing infrastructure, package-level architecture: New dependencies must justified added right field (Imports runtime, Suggests test-). Check target package’s namespace exports adding new dependency — several tidyselect helpers (all_of(), everything()) gtsummary formatters (style_pvalue(), style_sigfig()) already re-exported gtsummary, dplyr/tidyselect rarely need become hard Imports. CI runs R CMD check ---cran, lintr::lint_package(), test coverage (via Codecov), pkgdown site build push (.github/workflows/). checks must pass. Versioning: patch-digit bumps (0.9.0 → 0.9.1) fine incremental features fixes land. Never bump minor major digit without explicit maintainer direction — features accumulate current minor deliberate release consolidates . Every version bump updates DESCRIPTION NEWS.md. Breaking changes existing function signatures require NEWS.md entry; prefer adding new optional parameter backward-compatible default changing existing behavior (see hv_man_table_jtcvs()’s stat_label parameter worked example).

what: Manuscript-Compliant Table Construction for HVTI CORR Group
title: Manuscript-Compliant Table Construction for HVTI CORR Group
text: Full reference documentation worked examples: ehrlinger.github.io/hvtiRtables already know drill: hand-copy gtsummary table Word template, run SAS table macro, third revision footnote wording drifted, header re-merged , font quietly changed. hvtiRtables closes gap. Give gtsummary table object get back .docx already matches HVTI CORR’s “Table Construction Manuscripts” rules (house font rounding, footnotes abbreviation key text table, hidden spacer columns), way every time. Two house styles exist two audiences want different things header row. CORR reports manuscripts use flat, single header row (hv_man_table()); JTCVS submission wants traditional two-row spanning header instead (hv_man_table_jtcvs()). Use whichever matches table headed.

title: Manuscript-Compliant Table Construction for HVTI CORR Group
text: can install development version hvtiRtables GitHub :

title: Manuscript-Compliant Table Construction for HVTI CORR Group
code: library(gtsummary) library(hvtiRtables)  tbl <- tbl_summary(trial, by = trt, include = c(age, grade)) ft <- hv_man_table(tbl) hv_man_table_save(ft, "table1.docx")

title: Manuscript-Compliant Table Construction for HVTI CORR Group
text: ’re submitting JTCVS, swap hv_man_table_jtcvs() / hv_man_table_save_jtcvs() hv_man_table() / hv_man_table_save(). merged spanning header lettered footnotes match journal’s submission template, ’re hand-reformatting table second time flat-header version already done:
code: library(gtsummary) library(hvtiRtables)  tbl <- trial |>   tbl_summary(     by = trt,     statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{N_obs} ||| {mean} ± {sd}"),     include = c(age, grade)   )  ft <- hv_man_table_jtcvs(   tbl,   groups = c(stat_1 = "Drug A (n=98)", stat_2 = "Drug B (n=102)") ) hv_man_table_save_jtcvs(ft, "table1.docx", caption = "Table 1. Baseline Characteristics")

what: The house-standard manuscript table footnotes — hv_man_footnotes
title: The house-standard manuscript table footnotes — hv_man_footnotes
text: Two footnotes universal HVTI CORR "Table Construction Manuscripts" rules, specific one study, re-type every hv_man_table_save() call site: * non-missing-value count (house rule 8, exact wording required) † explaining {median} ({p15}, {p85}) format used continuous variables throughout tables. need footnote categorical n (%) format; column header text already covers (house rules 10/12).

title: The house-standard manuscript table footnotes — hv_man_footnotes
The house-standard manuscript table footnotes — hv_man_footnotes
text: named list elements `*` `†`, format hv_man_table_save()'s footnotes parameter expects.

title: The house-standard manuscript table footnotes — hv_man_footnotes
text: hv_man_table_save()'s footnotes parameter defaults calling function, every table gets automatically. Override ordinary list operations, special sentinel values needed: Suppress : footnotes = NULL Change one: modifyList(hv_man_footnotes(), list(...)) `†` = "custom text" Add study-specific one alongside: c(hv_man_footnotes(), list(...)) `‡` = "extra note"

title: The house-standard manuscript table footnotes — hv_man_footnotes
code: hv_man_footnotes() #> $`*` #> [1] "Number of non-missing values." #>  #> $`†` #> [1] "Median (15th, 85th percentile)." #>  modifyList(hv_man_footnotes(), list(`†` = "custom text")) #> $`*` #> [1] "Number of non-missing values." #>  #> $`†` #> [1] "custom text" #>

what: Convert a gtsummary table into a flextable matching HVTI CORR's table rules — hv_man_table
title: Convert a gtsummary table into a flextable matching HVTI CORR's table rules — hv_man_table
text: give gtsummary::tbl_summary() (gtsummary table object supporting gtsummary::as_flex_table()), get back flextable already complies HVTI CORR's "Table Construction Manuscripts" rules: single, non-merged header row (spanning parent cells grouped columns), merged row-group section-header cells, Times New Roman house font size.

title: Convert a gtsummary table into a flextable matching HVTI CORR's table rules — hv_man_table
code: hv_man_table(tbl, font = "Times New Roman", font_size = 12, digits = 2)

title: Convert a gtsummary table into a flextable matching HVTI CORR's table rules — hv_man_table
text: tbl gtsummary table object (must support as_flex_table()). font Font family. Default "Times New Roman" (house rule). font_size Font size points. Default 12; pass 11 wide tables, per house rule 5. values permitted. digits Kept interface symmetry future callers; currently unused (rounding controlled upstream via tbl_summary(digits = ...)). Reserved future version can enforce sig-fig rounding centrally without breaking signature change.

title: Convert a gtsummary table into a flextable matching HVTI CORR's table rules — hv_man_table
text: flextable object single header row merged cells, ready hv_man_table_save().

title: Convert a gtsummary table into a flextable matching HVTI CORR's table rules — hv_man_table
text: gtsummary::as_flex_table() already emits one header row per group self-contained labels (e.g. "B\nN = 45"), merged spanning header. one remaining merge, full-width gridSpan modify_table_body(groupname_col = ...) section-header row, gets removed flextable::merge_none(), un-merges every merged region back individual cells (content stays top-left cell former merge; rest become empty). satisfies "format table flat possible ... simple non-merged column titles" rule. Rounding, %-free percentage cells, ±-without-spaces formatting control, via statistic/digits arguments gtsummary::tbl_summary(); see package README worked example using gtsummary::style_sigfig() 2-significant-figure rounding. Submitting JTCVS instead? Use hv_man_table_jtcvs(), builds two-row merged spanning header journal's template expects: CORR house style JTCVS submission format want different things header row.

title: Convert a gtsummary table into a flextable matching HVTI CORR's table rules — hv_man_table
code: library(gtsummary) tbl <- tbl_summary(trial, by = trt, include = c(age, grade)) ft <- hv_man_table(tbl)

what: Build a JTCVS-format manuscript table with merged spanning headers — hv_man_table_jtcvs
title: Build a JTCVS-format manuscript table with merged spanning headers — hv_man_table_jtcvs
text: Use instead hv_man_table() building shape editorial actually needs JTCVS submission: 2-row header (group name spanning na/stat sub-columns) bold, light-blue-shaded, row-spanning section headers body, matching canonical "Table Construction Manuscripts" house example (section-header fill #CAEDFB). separate mode, replacement hv_man_table()'s flat-header CORR house style; two exist CORR reports JTCVS submissions want different things header row.

title: Build a JTCVS-format manuscript table with merged spanning headers — hv_man_table_jtcvs
code: hv_man_table_jtcvs(   tbl,   groups,   trailing = NULL,   font = "Times New Roman",   font_size = 12 )

title: Build a JTCVS-format manuscript table with merged spanning headers — hv_man_table_jtcvs
text: tbl gtsummary table object whose statistic argument used "{N_obs} ||| {<stat>}" every group column (see groups). groups Named character vector, stat_<k> column name tbl$table_body -> spanning header label (include group's N label text , e.g. c(stat_1 = "Group (n=60)")). trailing Optional named character vector length 1, existing tbl$table_body column name -> header label, trailing comparison column (e.g. c(std_diff = "Std. Diff.") c(p_value = "P")). Must already exist tbl$table_body. font Font family. Default "Times New Roman" (house rule). font_size Font size points. Default 12; pass 11 wide tables.

title: Build a JTCVS-format manuscript table with merged spanning headers — hv_man_table_jtcvs
text: flextable 2-row header merged section rows, ready hv_man_table_save_jtcvs().

title: Build a JTCVS-format manuscript table with merged spanning headers — hv_man_table_jtcvs
code: library(gtsummary) tbl <- trial |>   tbl_summary(     by = trt,     statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{N_obs} ||| {mean} ± {sd}"),     include = c(age, grade)   ) ft <- hv_man_table_jtcvs(   tbl,   groups = c(stat_1 = "Drug A (n=98)", stat_2 = "Drug B (n=102)") )

what: Write an hv_man_table() table to a compliant .docx — hv_man_table_save
title: Write an hv_man_table() table to a compliant .docx — hv_man_table_save
text: hand flextable (typically hv_man_table()), writes Word document footnotes abbreviation key rendered text table rather embedded within (house rules 13-14). flextable::footnote() : renders footnote text extra row inside table's <w:tbl> block ("footer" table part), exactly compliance violation function exists avoid. Instead, superscript reference symbol appended target header cell (normal, compliant reference mark), footnote text written genuine document paragraph table via officer::body_add_fpar(). table inserted directly (leading blank paragraph), keeps vertical cell alignment controllable later reformat surrounding document 1.5- double-spacing. House rule 2 concerns insertion point destination document, function's output; see package README paste-workflow.

title: hvtiRtables 0.9.0
text: Initial release. hv_man_table() converts gtsummary table object flextable complying HVTI CORR’s “Table Construction Manuscripts” rules (flat header, merged cells, house font/rounding rules). hv_man_table_save() writes .docx footnotes abbreviation key text table. hv_man_footnotes() supplies house-universal N median/percentile footnotes used hv_man_table_save()’s default. JTCVS submission mode: hv_man_table_jtcvs() builds merged-header flextable (spanning group headers, N/statistic column pairs) matching JTCVS journal submission template, hv_man_table_save_jtcvs() writes .docx bold Table N. Caption paragraph lettered (., b., …) footnotes targeted specific body cells. Section-header rows bold #CAEDFB shading column widths set explicitly, matching canonical “Table Construction Manuscripts” house example avoiding header/number wrapping flextable’s default column sizing produced.
